name: Vondra
tagline: The payroll infrastructure behind every frame that ships on time.
positioning: Vondra unifies union timecards, multi-jurisdiction residuals, and per-production tax logic into one system of record — so studios pay crews correctly the first time, across every shoot on the call sheet.

hero.h1: Payroll built for the scale of modern production.
hero.sub: Vondra runs wages, fringes, and residuals for every crew on every unit — reconciling union rules, state incentives, and overtime tiers in real time so your finance team closes the week without a single manual correction.

features.title: Union-aware timecard engine
features.description: Ingest crew timecards and Vondra applies the correct IATSE, DGA, and Teamsters rate cards, meal penalties, and turnaround rules automatically — flagging exceptions before they hit payroll.

features.title: Multi-jurisdiction tax logic
features.description: Loan-outs, per-diems, and cross-border shoots resolve to the right withholding and incentive filing for every state and country a production touches.

features.title: Residuals that never lapse
features.description: Track participation and residual obligations across titles and windows, with automated statements that hold up to guild audits.

features.title: Production cost visibility
features.description: Real-time labor spend rolls up by unit, department, and account code — feeding your cost report the moment a timecard is approved.

features.title: Audit-grade record keeping
features.description: Every rate, edit, and approval is versioned and traceable, giving finance and legal an immutable trail for guild and studio audits.

features.title: Enterprise integrations
features.description: Connect Vondra to your GL, budgeting, and HRIS stack with governed APIs and SSO built for studio-scale IT.

testimonials.quote: We ran four features and a limited series concurrently last quarter. Vondra reconciled every union rate and state incentive without a single amended check. Our payroll close went from nine days to two.
testimonials.name: Marisol Trevino

testimonials.quote: The residuals module alone justified the switch. What used to be a spreadsheet nightmare across forty titles is now an auditable statement we can defend to any guild.
testimonials.name: Devin Ashworth

testimonials.quote: Vondra's exception flags catch meal penalties and turnaround violations before payroll runs. Our production accountants finally trust the numbers on the cost report.
testimonials.name: Priya Raman
